description: Log query suite (spec §27.4) on 200k app-log events, 4 tenants; open-loop ingest + query load

ingest.label: closed-loop bulk load (throughput only). Burst, not sustained: it ends before compaction cycles complete, so it is not publishable as sustained ingest (STRATA-SYS-01-004/005).

insert_stages.note: upper bounds of the histogram bucket holding the quantile; budgets are spec VIII.1.2 targets for HW-REF-1 (1,000-row batches) and gate only on that profile (STRATA-SYS-01-002)

label: measurement only; not a capacity claim. Compare only runs with the same runner_fingerprint, durability and dataset.

report.label: open-loop: latency from intended send time (no coordinated omission)
open-loop: latency from intended send time (no coordinated omission)
closed-loop: throughput only; latencies are service times and understate queueing

queries.sql: SELECT event_time, body FROM logs WHERE trace_id = '8d9b9a5f3627f6e55ff25f124592b313'
SELECT event_time, body FROM logs WHERE attributes['request_id'] = 'req_df7728bfa81e'
SELECT event_time, service, body FROM logs WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-20T00:03:10.000000000Z' AND severity = 'ERROR' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT count(*) FROM logs WHERE service = 'auth' AND severity = 'WARN'
SELECT count(*) FROM logs WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-20T00:01:30.000000000Z' AND event_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-20T00:01:50.000000000Z'
SELECT count(*) FROM logs WHERE body LIKE '%TIMEOUT%'
SELECT count(*) FROM logs WHERE attributes['region'] = 'eu-west-1'
SELECT attributes['user_id'] AS u, count(*) AS n FROM logs GROUP BY attributes['user_id'] ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT service, time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', event_time) AS b, count(*) FROM logs GROUP BY service, time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', event_time)
SELECT attributes['error.code'] AS code, count(*) AS n FROM logs WHERE severity IN ('ERROR', 'FATAL') GROUP BY attributes['error.code'] ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT severity, count(*) FROM logs GROUP BY severity
SELECT count(*) FROM logs WHERE body LIKE '%deadlock detected%'
